headline: Bad debt must never breach the mutual reserve
subhead: Containing systemic risk requires strict mechanical boundaries around each debt position.

blocks.text: Pooled Architecture: Slippage leaks into shared capital, forcing passive depositors to absorb mutual haircuts.
Isolated Engine: Structural bulkheads quarantine delinquent debt, locking losses inside the distressed position.

focal.reason: Emphasizes how explicit containment boundaries prevent default contagion across the venue.
